 Manchester United rocked by injury to ‘devastated’ $133million star: ‘When it rains, it pours’
 Sacha Pisani 
 November 4, 2026 
 share 
 Facebook 
 X 
 WhatsApp 
 LinkedIn 
 Manchester United star Carlos Baleba succumbed to a hamstring injury in the embattled club’s UEFA Champions League clash with Roma on Wednesday (AEDT).
 Baleba hobbled off the pitch clutching his hamstring in a huge blow to struggling United, who were trailing 2-0 at the time prior to Bruno Fernandes reducing the deficit via the penalty spot.
 A $133million AUD signing from Brighton and Hove Albion, the Cameroon international made a run into the penalty area in the second half before pulling up short and going to ground at Old Trafford.
 Football360 members enjoy exclusive deals, discounts and experiences that make being a football fan more affordable. See what’s included > 
 “He looks devastated,” said commentator Gary Taphouse. “When it rains, it pours
 “What a dismal start to the second half… Honestly, you can barely believe it.”
 Baleba started the match for United, who were nine games without a win across all competitions before kick-off amid mounting pressure on head coach Michael Carrick.
 The 22-year-old arrived from Brighton in September but his debut was delayed due to injury.
 He has since made seven appearances for United, including four in the Premier League.
